note: No fact: the World Bank appraisal document of 22 December 2023 (excerpt, ending mid-sentence in section I.C) names no police force, station or police system. Its nearest content is on the justice side: legal/criminal records among 43 high-priority public services identified for digitalisation in April 2023, and 'administrative and legal proceedings' from the filing of complaints to the execution of sentences as one of three priority services to be digitised under the project, described as a justice-system process and not as a station record; neither is given as a named system.
